headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX erase early gains to trade lower after strong opening; TCS, Shriram Finance, among top gainers
headlines.summary: Indian equity indices erased their early market gains on Monday, November 23, as investors booking profits while focusing on FII investment sustainability and global market selloff amid steady oil prices and US Treasury yields.

headlines.headline: Reliance Retail to Adani Airports: These are 14 of India's most valuable unlisted companies
headlines.summary: NSE and Jio Platforms were considered to be the most valuable companies in the unlisted space before they made their market debut. The spotlight now shifts to other big companies that have high valuation in the unlisted space. From Reliance Retail to Parle Products, here are the 13 companies whose IPOs investors are looking forward to.

headlines.headline: ICICI Bank to Meesho: Top 5 stocks hit record highs on November 20; how much have they gained?
headlines.summary: Several stocks, including big names like ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, among others have rallied to hit a fresh record high on Friday, November 20, with investors focusing on the sustained FII buying support and the trend reversal powering the intraday gains.

headlines.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX gain 1%, NIFTY Bank scales new record high: Key triggers explained
headlines.summary: NIFTY Bank hits a record high for the third time in a week on Friday and crosses the 64,500 level for the first time.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 recover after weak open amid global selloff; JSW Steel, Tata Steel among top losers
headlines.summary: Indian equities witnessed a negative start on Friday, November 20, as selling pressure from Asia, elevated fixed income yields, and volatile geopolitical sentiment kept the investors in check. Here are key factors behind today's fall.

headlines.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 19: Maruti Suzuki soars nearly 8%, Eicher Motors surges 5%, TCS falls 2%; check list
headlines.summary: On November 19, the SENSEX jumped by 989.94 points or 1.21% to end at 83,021.75. Meanwhile, the NIFTY50 advanced by 286.35 points or 1.14% to close at its intraday high level of 25,514.30.

headlines.headline: Reliance, Hindustan Zinc and other metal stocks shine in Q2FY27 earnings; while auto sector faces pressure: Check key highlights
headlines.summary: The Q2FY27 earnings season which started in October 2026 served as one of key factors behind the broad-based market recovery. Q2 earnings performance was heavily mixed across sectors. Metals, oil and gas, and IT rebounded sharply, while Automobile sector posted lower profits due to soaring raw material costs.
